faceEvidence.why: 긴 뾰족한 코와 큰 입, 거친 흰 갈기를 긴 얼굴·각진 턱·또렷한 사람 코와 넓은 입·숱 있는 눈썹으로 해석한다. 코를 주둥이나 텐구 부리로 만들지 않는다.
cues: ‘shaggy white mane’ → 눈썹 숱 많고 결이 보이는
‘long, pointed nose’ → 코 크고 또렷한 코
faceEvidence.adjusted: 다른 종과 넷 이상 겹쳐 원작 단서의 다음 후보로 옮김 — 눈 간격 눈 하나 너비 안팎 → 눈 사이가 가까운

finalFacePrompt: FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): elongated face, long length, medium width; angular defined jaw; narrow eyes, medium size, level outer corners, close-set; feathered full brows; prominent defined nose; wide mouth.
comparisonScope: Viewed actual light + casual1/2/3 of each recent character in recent-comparison.jpg; prior batch characters also compared.
diversity_changes: Compared original recent race/trail/pottery, bodysuit/harvest/workshop and race/camp/records compositions; changed location, task, outfit silhouette and camera rather than copying those sets. Additional earlier batch rows included below.

retries.reason: Initial 3/4 head did not match profile_close, and low-rise bottom did not match high waist; both corrected from same target.
Shorts too short; lengthened to above kneecaps with original pose unchanged.
Initial skirt high-low front too short, neckline too low; corrected even below-knee skirt and shallow boat neck.

actualFaceComparison: Shiftry has a longer angular jaw/cheek plane, long projecting human nose, horizontal narrow eyes and firmer broad mouth. Seedot is compact and round-eyed; Nuzleaf has softer tapered chin, upturned almond eyes and thinner lips. White hair is supplemental, not the sole difference.
